meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入已有小说并整理成便于继续创作的格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有半成品小说想转入写作工具继续创作
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels and reorganize them for continued writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an unfinished novel you'd like to keep writing with a structured workflow.

howto.what: 它把用户已有的小说（半成品或完本）反向拆解成写作工程：生成拆文库分析和项目目录（设定/大纲/正文/追踪等），供后续长、短篇续写流程使用；按篇幅自动分流。
howto.when: 当用户发出“/story-import”“导入小说”“反向解析”等导入指令，或询问已有小说如何导入续写的流程问题时触发。

say.text: 导入《我的书》，文件路径是 C:\book.txt，做成可续写工程
say.note: 导入前会先确认书名、篇幅、末章是否完整等信息。

say.text: 只要拆文库分析，不用建项目结构——直接跑短篇拆解
这本书写到第 12 章还没完本，按长篇导入并继续

howto.what_en: It takes an existing novel (draft or complete) and rebuilds it as a writable project: analysis files plus a project structure (settings/outline/chapters/tracking), so later long/short writing skills can continue it.
howto.when_en: Triggered by commands like "/story-import", "导入小说", "反向解析", or when the user asks how to import an existing novel for continuation.

say_en.text: Import my book from C:\book.txt as a writable project.
say_en.note: It confirms book name, length, and last-chapter status before analyzing.

say_en.text: Just produce the analysis; skip the project migration.
This draft stops at chapter 12; import it as long-form.
